findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms require you to wait three months after invoicing to get paid, which creates severe cash flow challenges for a freelancer.
findings.suggested_change: Change the payment terms to Net 30 or require payment within 15 days of invoice receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a small modification before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause where invoices are payable Net 90, waiting three months to receive payment creates cash flow challenges, so I propose we change the payment terms to Net 30. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
